Game Overview

In Super Pig on Xmas, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a festive adventure in Super Pig on Xmas. Navigate a charming 2D platformer as a determined pig, collecting candies and dodging menacing obstacles. Master precise double jumps and skillful maneuvers across eight exhilarating levels. Will you overcome the escalating challenges and fulfill the piglet’s Christmas dreams?
